title: Amphitheater
details: An open-air stage for gatherings, cultural evenings and religious events.

title: Kids' play area, badminton & cricket box
details: A dedicated play zone for children, with a badminton court and a box cricket area.

title: Gate 5 opened
details: A new exit gate for the community, easing the load on the existing gates.

title: Ganesha Temple
details: Built and maintained by the community, with the anniversary celebrated every year.

title: Security cabins at Gate 1 & Gate 5
details: Proper manned cabins, so guards are stationed and sheltered at both gates.

title: Clear parking demarcation
details: Every bay marked out in hot paint, so allotted parking is unambiguous.

title: Association office
details: A permanent office for the Association, its records and resident walk-ins.

title: Yoga room
details: A quiet indoor room set aside for yoga and fitness sessions.

title: Lit walkways through the gardens
details: Elevated walkways through the planted areas, lit for safe use after dark.

title: Kitchen area renovated
details: The common kitchen refitted for use during functions and celebrations.

title: Clean & dry driveways
details: The garden pipes were concealed to keep the driveway dry and neat.

title: Fire extinguishers installed
details: Extinguishers fitted across the blocks and the common areas.

title: Storerooms at multiple locations
details: Secure storage added at several points for equipment and society material.

title: Swimming pool renovated
details: The pool refurbished and brought back into regular use.

title: Solar fencing restored
details: The perimeter solar fence repaired and made live again.

title: Cellar water leakage resolved
details: Most of the water leakage issues in the cellars have been resolved.
